findings.claim: EPA glyphosate page updated August 26, 2026 describes a new human-health review expected late 2026 and a literature-comment deadline September 24. The 2020 interim decision was vacated in part and subsequently withdrawn in 2022. EPA continues to describe its prior no-risk-of-concern conclusion; this is not a completed new review.

IARC classified glyphosate probably carcinogenic to humans (Group 2A) in March 2015; a hazard classification does not estimate individual risk at a specified exposure. Regulatory risk assessment, hazard identification and litigation are distinct evidence lanes.
Bayer own history acknowledges its incorporation into IG Farben and forced labor. This is material historical conduct, not evidence of the intent of present employees or every current decision.

No evidence established that Bayer is causing the current sulfur/phosphate constraint or intentionally withholding nutrients. Track seed/input access, distributor fulfillment, licensing/concentration, litigation cash commitments, operational changes, ecological/health evidence, research integrity and viable agronomic substitutes separately.
